findings.finding: An open $100M at-the-market program with Maxim (prospectus 2026-09-11, under the F-3 declared effective 2026-06-10) can sell ordinary shares into the 2026-10-07 session. It sits over a company worth about $42M at $1.22, beside 4M unlocked Landvision consideration shares registered for resale on 2026-09-08.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is live and can be drawn on any trading day without a new filing, so supply can land on 10-07. ATM sales are disclosed only periodically, so the market cannot see whether the program is spent.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the ATM opened, MKDW's next-session closes after its falls were -1.64 (09-14), -17.87 (09-18), -20.37 (09-21), -9.30 (09-22), -1.92 (09-23) and -11.59 (10-05): 6 of 6 negative. Before the ATM, its falls in March and April mostly bounced (+3.97, +11.59, +4.61, +32.02, +14.42).
findings.why_not_priced: The fall prices the supply that has already been sold, not supply still to come. A $100M program on a ~$42M market cap has notional room many times what has traded, and no 6-K says it is complete. If the price held the rest of it, falls on thin volume like today's would mean-revert the way the pre-ATM falls did. Since September they have not.

That cannot resolve before mid-November at the earliest.
Lock-up on 26M of the 30M Landvision consideration shares: 20% released 6 months after completion (about Feb 2027), then 20% at 12 months, 20% at 18 months and 40% at 24 months.
